items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I think Yvonne said Papa was kind of hard to get.

ctx.x: Yes, my father was introduced to my mother by a good friend of hers and a neighbor of ours who lived next door, and Von just reminded me that my father played baseball. He was a very good baseball player, and a good musician, which he and worked, played together in the same band, you know, in the beginning. And that's how they got married. And -- but since Mother was married before -- and I think Yvonne said Papa was kind of hard to get.
